name: tps-band
description: Output tokens per second for each model response, in the band above the prompt

speedMode.title: Speed mode
speedMode.description: Which speed to show: generation (first token to stop), end-to-end (request to stop), or both

retainSeconds.title: Keep the last reading
retainSeconds.description: Seconds the last reading stays after a turn ends; 0 keeps it until the next turn

showSparkline.title: Show a sparkline
showSparkline.description: Draw a small sparkline of recent response speeds

modelLabels.title: Model labels
modelLabels.description: Comma-separated model id=label pairs; a trailing * matches a prefix. E.g. mythos-magpie-1855118842=Opus 5.5,deepseek-*=DeepSeek
